title: Budget-aware prefill mediator and compact quant regulator
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Large tenants observed unpredictable token costs during bursty traffic due to overly aggressive prefill and one-size-fits-all quant profiles. This PR introduces a budget-aware prefill mediator that dynamically moderates prefill aggressiveness based on tenant unit-econ targets, and a compact quant regulator that applies conservative quantization profiles at the tenant boundary to reduce unit cost while preserving quality. Summary of changes: 1) prefill/mediator: new package that samples recent request distributions, computes a tenant budget headroom score and adjusts prefill window and sample rates; 2) quant/regulator: policy engine that maps workload signatures to a ranked set of compact quant profiles with a safe rollback threshold; 3) cli/sim: offline simulator CLI to dry-run tenant policy decisions against replayed traffic; 4) telemetry: new prefills.budget_{score,action} counters, quant.regulator_decision histogram and unit_econ.delta gauge; 5) rollout: feature flag controlled, defaults off for existing tenants, opt-in via tenant config. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-1987 - [x] unit tests for mediator scoring logic - [x] integration tests with sample workloads - [x] telemetry + dashboards stubbed - [x] CLI dry-run with sample replay - [x] docs: console-config and API notes Drafting notes: conservative defaults chosen to avoid regressions; quant regulator supports explicit whitelist for models where quantization is unsafe. Testing summary: unit tests cover 94% of mediator code paths; integration runs with the small replay dataset show median cost reduction 12% and p95 latency increase <2% in synthetic bench. Deployment notes: staged rollout to canary tenants for two weeks, monitor quant.regulator_decision failures and unit_econ.delta, automatic rollback to previous quant profile on quality regressions. Related: touches tenant defaults, rollout system and telemetry schema so coordinate with infra and observability teams.

review_comments: Marcus Nguyen: Overall looks solid; two concerns: 1) the mediator's moving average window is fixed at 5m—can we make it adaptive or config-driven?; 2) quant.profile ranking lacks an explicit failure budget metric. Please add config knobs and tests.
Author (Aisha): Addressed both. Exposed window and smoothing params as tenant-level overrides and added failure_budget to profile metadata. Added unit tests for failure budget enforcement.
Elena Rossi: Integration tests show a small p95 latency bump in the bursty-sms scenario. Can we add a safety gate to refuse prefill expansion if p95 exceeds tenant SLO?
Author: Added safety gate check that evaluates p95 from recent traces; prefill step is skipped if predicted p95 delta > 5% of tenant SLO. Added integration test to validate gating.
Jonah Kim: Telemetry metric names look good. Please include an alert suggestion in the PR for ops on quant.regulator_decision >= 3 failures per minute.
Author: Added alert note to docs and included a sample grafana alert rule in dashboards.
release_notes: Introduces a budget-aware prefill mediator and compact quant regulator to reduce per-token costs for tenants. Opt-in feature behind tenant config; includes CLI for dry-run simulations and telemetry for monitoring. Potential cost improvements of ~10-15% observed in small replays. Rollout controlled via feature flag and canary tenants.
